headline: Enter 50 Contests Free
music_label: Background music (plays on open; tap ♪ to mute)
disclaimer: This app lists third-party contests. We do not run them or guarantee any prize; each sponsor's official rules apply. Google is not a sponsor of, or involved in, any contest listed.
not_served: Sorry, this app is not offered in your country yet.

delete_confirm: Delete your account and all its data on this device? This cannot be undone. Any paid plan must also be cancelled in Google Play or the App Store.
location_note: Only contests open to your selected location are shown. You must still check each contest's official rules.
renews_note: Renews automatically each month until you cancel.
pl_head: Every contest we can find, worldwide. Cancel anytime.
pl_android: Subscribe in the Android app. Plans are sold only through Google Play in the Android app. The free tier works here.
pl_renew: Plus applicable taxes. Renews automatically until you cancel in Google Play; access lasts to the end of the paid period. Your first 50 tracked entries are free, with no card and no automatic upgrade.
pl_billed: Billed by Google Play. This app never sees your card.
pl_manage: Manage or cancel in Google Play
pl_not_country: The paid plans are not offered in your country yet. The free tier still works where the app is served.
